# Architecture Decisions

## Use Redis for the job queue (2026-01-05)

SUPERSEDED on 2026-02-01 by the SQLite WAL queue decision below; Redis was removed from the stack and nothing depends on it any more.

## Migrate CI to GitHub Actions (2026-01-08)

COMPLETED 2026-01-20: all pipelines moved; the old Jenkins server was decommissioned. Nothing left to decide.

## Pin every flake input (2026-01-02)

Still in force: every flake input is pinned in flake.lock and updated only through the update target. This constrains all future dependency changes.

## Job queue: SQLite in WAL mode (2026-02-01)

Replaces the Redis queue; local-only, so SQLite suffices.

turns.text: Staging health checks keep flapping. Why?
Root cause: the staging load balancer rate-limits health probes; any interval under 15s gets 429s and marks the api down. Set the interval back to 30s; flapping stopped.
Good, remember that: never go under 15s on staging.
